title: Compliant inner lip on a vacuum gripper

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.quote: The suction device 100 can have a main body 104 with a collar 106 that enables a lip assembly 108 to be attached to the main body.
features.note: The reference describes a main body that is part of a suction device, which can be gripped.
features.refuted: The quote describes a main body with a collar for attachment, not a housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: Traditionally vacuum grippers and suction devices are designed to either work with items that have soft flexible packaging, or hard surfaces.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper or suction device, which implies a vacuum generating device. While not explicitly stated as 'electrically operated' or 'in the housing', it is the standard for such devices.
features.refuted: The quote discusses traditional vacuum grippers working with different surfaces, but does not teach an electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe the path of exhaust air from the vacuum generating device, nor does it mention guiding it through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device or material.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The suction device 500 has a lip assembly 502 with an inner lip 506 and an outer lip 504 .
features.note: The lip assembly with inner and outer lips functions as a sealing element for suction, similar to a suction plate with a seal.
features.refuted: The quote describes inner and outer lips, not a suction plate with a carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.quote: The vacuum gripper can be mounted on an end of arm tool of a robotic arm and can therefore be configured to work with a wide variety of packages and package types.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper that can be mounted on a robotic arm, implying a grip unit and vacuum generator. However, it does not mention exhaust air routing through the grip or sound-damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: In an embodiment, a vacuum gripper or a suction device can include a main body and a lip assembly attached to the main body
features.note: The reference describes a suction device comprising a main body (grip unit) and a lip assembly (suction plate) attached to it.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material or lining in the grip portion.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: In an embodiment, a vacuum gripper or a suction device can include a main body and a lip assembly attached to the main body
features.note: The reference implies a vacuum generating device within the main body (housing), but does not specify it being completely in a 'first housing portion' or delineate housing portions.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in any housing portion.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between distinct housing portions or an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe any air baffles or mechanisms for directing exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles related to it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: The lip assembly can also be detachably attached to the main body.
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the lip assembly (suction plate) can be detachably attached to the main body (grip unit).

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: a lip assembly attached to the main body, wherein the lip assembly comprises an inner lip that extends into a cavity formed by the lip assembly and the main body
features.note: The main body (grip unit) and lip assembly (suction plate) form a cavity, which is the suction chamber, implying a fluidic connection for suction.
features.refuted: The quote describes an inner lip extending into a cavity, but does not teach a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a suction device or vacuum gripper, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.

claims.quote: Various embodiments disclosed herein provide for a lip assembly for a vacuum gripper or suction device that is designed to work well with both soft flexible packages and articles with rigid surfaces.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper or suction device, which can be considered a type of vacuum generating device, but it does not explicitly mention a housing with a grip portion for gripping the unit.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper and suction device, but does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper and suction device, but does not mention a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper and suction device, but does not mention a vacuum generating device being arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper and suction device, but does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or the housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a vacuum gripper with a main body and lip assembly, but does not describe a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not mention an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection and passing of exhaust air to a grip portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not mention a grip portion, housing portions, or air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

claims.quote: Various embodiments disclosed herein provide for a lip assembly for a vacuum gripper or suction device that is designed to work well with both soft flexible packages and articles with rigid surfaces.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper or suction device, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a lip assembly for a vacuum gripper, not a complete vacuum handling apparatus as asserted.

claims.quote: The lip assembly can have a compliant or flexible inner lip that soft packages can blossom over when suction is applied, while the outer lip of the lip assembly is also suited to working with hard, rigid packages.
claims.note: The reference discloses a lip assembly with an inner and outer lip, which functions as a seal. However, it does not explicitly mention a carrier plate to which the seal is fastened or that the seal extends around the carrier plate.
The reference does not contain claim 1, so it cannot disclose a grip unit according to claim 1.

claims.quote: The lip assembly can also be detachably attached to the main body.
claims.note: This quote explicitly states that the lip assembly can be detachably attached to the main body, which is equivalent to the grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected.
claims.refuted: The quote discusses detachable attachment of a lip assembly to a main body, not a grip unit and suction plate connected via a coupling device.

claims.quote: The main body 104 can also include a cavity portion 102 through which the gripper 100 can be attached to an end of a robotic arm and through which pipes and or other means of applying suction to the suction
claims.note: The reference describes a cavity portion in the main body through which means of applying suction are facilitated, leading to a suction device. This implies a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum.
claims.refuted: The quote is incomplete and only mentions applying suction through a cavity portion, not a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a main body and a lip assembly, which aligns well with the concepts of a grip unit and suction plate.
